name: Neuenkirchen (Lower Saxony, Germany)
description: Horizontally divided yellow over green, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Neuenkirchen (a black church between oak leaves on yellow and green).
history: The colours green and gold refer to the agricultural character of the place; the flag is divided with the arms, as described in the municipal charter.

features.role: Neuenkirchen arms — church between oak leaves
